context_detail.example: GA 34 wk / postnatal day 2 / post-op day 1

frequency_ordered_minutes.note: set by doctor order; overdue flag at frequency + 15 min

clinical_time.rule: PX-X-04 — stored separately from system_time; late_entry flag if system_time - clinical_time > 60 min

nurse_concern.note: nurse concern alone is a valid trigger — SOP-11 §1

shock_index.label: significant haemorrhage even if blood not visible

computed.red_count: number of fields in red zone (nurse_concern counts as 1)
computed.amber_count: number of fields in amber zone
computed.hypertensive_emergency: systolic_bp >= 160 OR diastolic_bp >= 110 → separate red banner: treat within 30 min (OBG-SOP-03; OBG-F-15)

then: create task: resident at bedside within 30 min
repeat observations within 30 min (auto-sets next due)

escalation_rules.when: red_count >= 2 OR (E1 open for 60 min without improvement)
then: suggest pathway buttons: Sepsis-six (OBG-ALG-07) / PPH (OBG-ALG-01) / Severe HTN (OBG-ALG-02)
suggest PPH chart (Build 15) if postnatal ≤ 24 h

escalation_rules.when: observation overdue by 15 min versus frequency_ordered_minutes
then: worklist flag for the ward nurse

print.layout: A4 landscape, 12 observation columns per sheet, rows = parameters with RED/AMBER threshold columns, totals row, action row, signature row — identical to OBG-F-05 master

kpi_feeds.indicator: MEOWS completed 4-hourly in the first 24 h postnatal
kpi_feeds.numerator: stays with no overdue observation in first 24 h

kpi_feeds.indicator: Suspected sepsis: antibiotics within 1 h of trigger
kpi_feeds.numerator: E1/E2 triggers with sepsis pathway where antibiotic_time - trigger_time <= 60 min
hypertensive_emergency flags with antihypertensive given <= 30 min

acceptance_tests: HR 125 + SBP 88 → shock_index 1.42, red_count 2, consultant task created, PPH suggestion shown
Temp 37.6 + pulse 105 → amber_count 2 → E1 fires; resident task with 30-min due
Frequency 240 min; last obs 10:00; at 14:16 the stay shows overdue
Entry at 03:40 with clinical_time 02:10 shows 'late entry' on screen and print
Print of a 24-h sheet matches OBG-F-05 side by side
